messages:
maria: quick check-in 11 dropped a compact Figma for bulk-rotation + revoke/undo flows: https://www.figma.com/file/JKL101 (see /compact-batch). want quick takes on copy, keyboard flow, and emergency safeguards.

lee: skimmed. tiny a11y items: ensure modal focus lands on the title and the undo toast is tabbable + announced. stepper tab order should follow action order (Back -> Next -> Confirm).

jess: copy nit: don't say 'cannot be undone' if we provide undo. suggest: "Revoked keys can be restored for 14 days from Activity". Keep "Delete" language for permanent removal.

rachel: for batch rotate results, show per-key status chips: Rotated / Skipped / Failed. clicking Failed shows friendly reason + 'Retry' (avoid raw errors).

oliver: security: require stronger confirmation for org/system keys. prefer "type key name to confirm" for those; checkbox OK for normal keys. also show a red banner: "System key: rotating may interrupt services."

maria: what about CTA defaults? option A: "Rotate & revoke old keys" (safe) vs B: "Create rotated copies" (safer for integrations). we should detect key-type.

jess: detect key-type and pick default accordingly. also surface a short impact summary: "May affect X services" collapsed by default.

lee: empty-state suggestion: illustration + microcopy "No keys yet 1 Create one and rotate regularly". ensure the primary CTA is keyboard focusable and has descriptive aria-label.

rachel: permission flow: instead of disabling batch actions, show inline "Request access" button that opens a prefilled request modal. reduces dead ends.

maria: plan: - standardize undo window to 14d, toast 12s and tabbable - update wording Revoke vs Delete - add type-to-confirm for system keys - detect key-type for CTA default - inline request-access flow. I'll update Figma tonight and ping when ready.

devops-bot: Deploy queued: feature/cred-ux/compact-batch -> staging (build 511).

maria: thanks all 1 will add notes to the component spec about focus order and aria attributes. will follow up after staging tests.
